name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the ban clause is too strong. The task is "Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once", i.e. key_lost is forbidden only before door_open has occurred at least once. The candidate uses a hard Absence(key_lost), which forbids key_lost for the whole episode. Replace the Absence(key_lost) with a hard Precedence(door_open, key_lost) so that dropping while the door is closed is allowed after door_open has happened once. Keep the hard Existence(at_goal) for Reach the goal.
